description: This PHP source file defines the GreaterThanOperator class, which implements comparison logic for 'greater than' filter operations within the SuiteCRM JSON API filtering system. It includes methods for returning filter and SQL operators, and validating input operators.

classes.name: GreaterThanOperator
classes.description: A class representing the 'greater than' comparison operator for filtering in the SuiteCRM JSON API.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter tag 'gt' representing the 'greater than' filter operation.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL operator '>' for 'greater than' comparison.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates if the provided operator is a string and passes parent class validation.
